01 / About

I'm an Oracle DBA and Banner systems administrator at the University of Tennessee at Martin, where I've spent the last five years keeping the university's Ellucian Banner ERP running, first as a programmer/analyst writing PL/SQL and integrations, and now administering the databases underneath it. I have a B.S. in Computer Science, and outside the database I still love full-stack work: this site is hand-built with vanilla JavaScript, SCSS, and a small Node build.
